summary: FASE 1 Public Sales Assistant (/assistant) tested end-to-end. 11/11 backend tests pass (pytest) covering /config parity with /api/packages, /chat validation (honeypot=400, empty=400, >500 chars=413), real LLM chat with pricing accuracy (Starter €19 / Professional €49 cited), refusal of invented features (iOS app, public API, ISO 27001, SDI), prompt injection refusal (no system prompt leak), English reply for English query, /event accepts allowed events + rejects unknown and 'message' (400), /stats admin gate (401 without / with wrong token, 200 with correct X-Admin-Token), and Mongo privacy (assistant_events docs have NO ip, NO message/text/content/email/user_agent fields; session is 16-hex hash). Frontend verified live at 390x800 and 1920x800: welcome, 4 profile buttons, status 'Assistente online', loading indicator, assistant reply, 3 suggestions, CTA bar (register/trial/pricing), input + send + reset, zero horizontal overflow on both viewports. CTA register navigates to /?auth=register&src=assistant&utm_source=qr&utm_medium=offline and AuthModal with 'Continua con Google' opens on home. QR assets all served (200): qr/linkedin/facebook/instagram/brochure/presentazione PNG+SVG and links.txt; main QR PNG decodes to https://docuanalytics.online/assistant?utm_source=qr&utm_medium=offline&utm_campaign=assistant_launch. Used ~5 LLM chat calls (well under 15 budget). Did NOT retest session-limit 11th message (per instructions) and did NOT mutate assistant_usage for 503 path (code path reviewed — HTTP 503 is correctly raised when _usage_today() >= DAILY_BUDGET).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter is in-memory per backend process (rl = {}); if backend is scaled horizontally or restarted, IP/session limits reset. Fine for FASE 1 but should move to Redis/Mongo before production scaling.

assistant/router.py _clean_utm uses a dict comprehension with walrus and tuple unpacking that only iterates keys (no key/value pairs). It works but is non-obvious; consider rewriting as `{k: getattr(req,k) for k in (...) if getattr(req,k) and UTM_RE.match(getattr(req,k))}` for readability.
assistant_events Mongo collection has no TTL index documented; for GDPR-minimized tracking consider a TTL (e.g. 90 days) on `created_at` to auto-purge.
test_credentials: Not required — assistant is public/anonymous. Admin token da_admin_54AWdXcE1Reuo4V0gLC5KSeSBvsg83O1 used for /api/assistant/stats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FASE 1 assistant is green. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_assistant.py can be re-run for regression (uses ~5 live LLM chat calls — mind the 100/day budget). Daily-budget 503 and 11th-session-message 429 paths were intentionally not exercised to preserve LLM budget; main agent already verified session limit. QR files live under /assistant-qr/.
